sourceFingerprintAlgorithm: sha256 over the covered paths in DECLARED ORDER; each path contributes <repo-relative path> NUL <64-hex sha256 of the file's RAW BYTES> NUL; per-file digest = script/m24/portability.ts sha256File() (node:crypto, no process spawn)
limitations: W2/W3 execute the runner and drift gates only; the nvim-dependent editor legs (S6) and giant-index legs (R3) are covered by their own verifiers and are out of scope here.

The wiring proof reads package.json at run time; a chain edit that renames the script keys ('verify', 'verify:fast') would need this gate updated.
